title: ID0387112-DC/Si-D/NL-[STBpCB] OCPP unstable
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
OCPP unstable
Root cause: SINR is low
Solution:
disabled WAN Failover
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: Siemens Employee
Warranty Status:ACTIVE

additional_info.subject: FW: Re:[## 3071 ##] Laadpunt Van Dijk Culemborg
additional_info.body:
Hi colleagues,
Our customer, with charger ID STBpCB, reports that authorizations of charging sessions regularly fail. Might have something to do with the stability of the OCPP connection, since the OCPP back-end reports a regular connection loss. Could you look into this and check if everything is fine on our end?
Thomas

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0387112-DC/Si-D/NL-[STBpCB] OCPP unstable CRM:01811000414
additional_info.body:
Hello Thomas,
I wanted to inform you that we disabled WAN Failover for the wired connection.
It will allow the system to retry the mobile connection when the mobile signal is lost, instead of attempting to use a wired connection that isn’t available.
Please note that if the mobile signal is weak, we may still experience disconnections. I’ve observed that the SINR (Signal to Interference plus Noise Ratio) is low, which could indicate coverage issues.
If you have any questions or need further assistance, please let me know.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita Khobare
